control_metrics.label: Chlorine shortfalls
control_metrics.numerator: Number of monitored node-time observations with chlorine below 0.2 mg/L
control_metrics.denominator: Eligible monitored node-time observations in the reference-normal part of the main window

control_metrics.label: Chlorine excesses during normal operation
control_metrics.numerator: Number of monitored node-time observations with chlorine above 0.4 mg/L
control_metrics.denominator: Eligible monitored node-time observations in the reference-normal part of the main window

control_metrics.label: Transported arsenic burden
control_metrics.aggregation: The total is the sum of the main-window and tail-window components.

control_metrics.label: Chlorine ceiling violations
control_metrics.numerator: Number of monitored node-time observations with chlorine above 5.0 mg/L in the reference-event regime
control_metrics.denominator: Eligible monitored node-time observations in the reference-event regime
control_metrics.aggregation: The total pools main-window and tail-window numerators and denominators. Window fractions are never averaged or added.

control_metrics.label: Arsenic clearance lead
control_metrics.aggregation: Mean clearance lead within the common paired eligible event population of each case, then applicable cases within each scenario and equal scenario weights. No-exceedance clusters are reported separately; no additive main/tail decomposition.

control_metrics.label: Evaluated chlorine use
control_metrics.aggregation: The total is the sum of main-normal, main-event, and tail-event use.

control_metrics.label: Undiscounted evaluation return
control_metrics.aggregation: The total is the undiscounted sum of original, unnormalized rewards over the main window and complete clearance tail, including reference-normal tail samples, after warm-up.

forecast_metrics.label: Forecast mean absolute error
forecast_metrics.derivation: For each training seed, fold, scenario, and horizon step, divide absolute_error_sum_mg_l by observation_count. Average scenario values equally, then model errors across folds within each seed. Report the mean and sample standard deviation across seed means.

forecast_metrics.label: Forecast root mean squared error
forecast_metrics.derivation: For each training seed, fold, scenario, and horizon step, take the square root of squared_error_sum_mg2_l2 divided by observation_count. Average scenario RMSE values equally, then model errors across folds within each seed. Report the mean and sample standard deviation across seed means.
